result.long_session_is_supported: Yes. A 112,626-token real-source prompt prefilled in 27.743 s and decoded 128 tokens at 117.1 tok/s with the 256K context, and the 262,144-cell KV cost only 1.80 GiB of pinned RAM because 32,768 hot cells per QSA layer stayed in VRAM and 92.14 percent of KV block reads hit VRAM.
result.ram_is_not_the_bottleneck: B550 has 91 GiB and about 85-88 GiB available while idle. The KV cache needs 1.80 GiB of it at 256K INT8, and the expert arena needs about 32 GiB. RAM is not what limits this workload.
result.more_ram_is_harmful_here: --ple-io ram was 2.52x slower to prefill (1609.2 versus 4059.5 tok/s) and 1.89x slower to decode (61.9 versus 117.1 tok/s) than --ple-io direct, and it cost 18.2 s of startup to lock the 28.8 GiB table. Locking that much RAM evicts the page cache the expert arena and the table themselves are read through, which is why a 2.5 GiB NVMe with the file cache warm beats a 91 GiB RAM table on this host.
result.kv_handling_summary: KV is INT8 (1,056 B per cell per QSA layer, 12 QSA layers), 32,768 hot cells per layer resident in VRAM, the full 262,144-cell table in pinned host RAM, served from VRAM for about 92 percent of reads.
result.remaining_lever: The KV path is not where the time goes. Decode at 117.1 tok/s with a 99.5 percent expert-cache hit rate and 92 percent VRAM KV hits is limited by the launch-bound per-layer pipeline and the 61 of 87 accepted MTP drafts, not by KV or RAM.

non_claims: One prompt and one 128-token generation per arm; not a session-length sweep, and no long-context quality or correctness comparison was run.
The 112,626-token prompt is real engine source but is not a multi-turn agent session with tool calls; the repeated-turn path (conversation checkpoints, prompt cache reuse) was not exercised.
The direct-versus-RAM comparison is one run each on this host with a warm page cache; it does not establish the crossover point for other hosts, table sizes, or cold-cache starts.
No claim is made about the 2.5 GiB Optane or any other storage change, and none was made; the host's root NVMe was used as-is.

Explicit hugepages are 0 on this host, so the 1.80 GiB pinned KV was pinned without large pages; a hugepage-backed arena was measured in an earlier A/B and rejected, and that decision was not revisited here.
Another session's mlx_gptq.dflash2_distill jobs were running on GPU0 during the final state check; they were observed and left untouched, and they were not present during the measured windows.
